review.summary: Documentation accurately reflects the implementation: MIND plugin (1.0.0) is skills-only without automatic Core installation; Agentic Eros remains persona-neutral with non-erotic defaults and explicit authority boundaries; associative reminders are strictly serendipitous/contextual, never top-K or scalar selection; evidence verbs distinguish static packages from local behavior; accessibility structure in Pages source meets requirements.
passed_areas: Installation flow correctly distinguishes plugin (1.0.0) from optional Core (0.2.0)
Agentic Eros boundaries match faculty-registry.json and SKILL.md constraints
Associative reminder claims align with H0/query-capable reality in OPTIONAL-CORE.md
Pages source accessibility structure is complete (skip-link, headings, alt text)
Evidence verbs correctly separate static/package from local behavior/installation
review.evidence_boundary: Documentation surface and repository evidence are consistent; no material discrepancies found between claims and implementation reality.
